## Invitations

A total of 1460 people were invited to the River Districts outreach activity. Attendance was 223 people, representing an attendance rate of 15.3 per cent. This result records the number invited alongside the number who attended and provides the basis for reporting participation in the outreach activity.

The attendance figure should be considered in relation to the invitation total. The reported rate is intended to give a clear summary of participation and to support consistent review of outreach activity.

## Contact

No invitations were sent by SMS. The number of invitations sent by SMS was 0. No reminder messages were issued, and the number of people who received a reminder message was 0.

These contact figures are recorded separately from attendance. They indicate that the outreach activity did not use SMS invitations or reminder messages during the reporting period. The information provides a concise record of the contact methods used and supports future review of invitation and reminder arrangements.
